# Runtime dependencies actually imported by the EduPlus backend.
# (The original dev machine's full `pip freeze` is not part of the repository:
# requirements.full.txt is git-ignored.)

# Core framework -- version taken from the migrations ("Generated by Django 6.0.6"),
# NOT from the old freeze dump, which claimed 5.1.5 and would break migrations.
Django==6.0.6

# API layer. Pinned to the version the verified image resolved: there is no
# lock file, so a floating ">=" would let each rebuild pick a different DRF.
djangorestframework==3.18.1
django-cors-headers==4.7.0

# Settings / .env loading (config/settings.py: `import environ`)
django-environ==0.12.0

# PostgreSQL driver
psycopg[binary]==3.3.3

# Google Sheets sync (invitations); unrelated to Learn authentication
google-auth==2.49.2
gspread==6.1.4

# Background jobs: the scheduled enrolment-sheet quota sync
# (students.tasks + config/celery.py). Redis is the broker.
celery==5.4.0
redis==5.2.1
# Celery's own dependencies, pinned to the set the worker last ran with:
# celery 5.4.0 accepts any kombu below 6, and kombu 5.7 (3 Nov 2026) needs redis-py 6.1+.
kombu==5.6.2
amqp==5.4.1
billiard==4.3.1

# Serving
gunicorn==23.0.0
whitenoise==6.6.0

# Report PDFs (reports app, design F.2): HTML and CSS to PDF. It lays text out
# with Pango, which the Dockerfile installs.
weasyprint==70.0

# Hosted Checkout links and signed payment webhooks.
stripe==16.1.0

# Authenticated encryption of retrievable initial credentials (key outside DB).
cryptography==50.0.2
